criteria.C3_calls_primary: median(A1 调用数)/median(codex 调用数) <= 0.70 (主判据: 不必要的远端请求变少)
criteria.C4_effective_tokens: median(A1 新算 prompt + completion)/median(codex 同量) <= 0.70
criteria.C5_nominal_tokens: median(A1 prompt+completion)/median(codex 同量) <= 0.70 (R413 逐字口径, 分列报告)
